EXIT lines are the command's own status. Each of 01/02/03/05 was produced by redirecting the full unpiped output to a file and capturing $? immediately; there is no tail or pipe that could mask a failure (the 2e12225 precedent used 'tail' on 02 and 05; this run records 02 in full, 104 lines).
